q2_gaps: A capitalized PLURAL multi-word name whose head word is itself the kind word ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the multi-word-name rule licenses a type atom from the kind word sitting inside the name (Kestrel River -> (Member kestrel_river river)), while the capitalized-plural-label carve-out says a plural kind-word label referring as a name is a Name-only individual with no per-member kind from the label word; nothing settles which governs here, nor whether a named plural set gets any group treatment.
notes: Whenever-machinery, plain-variable premise, Skolem consequent, During link, TV and the no-companion rule are all applied correctly. Lemmatization collapses the noun "bloom" and the verb "bloom" onto one symbol, so (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) and the event class (Member (sk_bloom $e) bloom) put the substance and the blooming event in the same class.
